articles.summary: Jefferies Healthcare Services and Technology Conference and 19th Annual Barrington Research Virtual Fall Investment Conference Covista (NYSE: CVSA), America’s largest healthcare educator, announced today that it will participate in two investor conferences this September: Jefferies Healthcare Services and Technology Conference: Steve Beard, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer, Covista, and Bob Phelan, Chief Financial Officer, Covista, will present at the conference in Nashville, Tennessee, on Monday, September 14, 2026, at 9:10 a.m. CT. The fireside chat will be available via webcast and replay here and available on the Investor Relations section of Covista's website at https://investors.covista.com/ . 19th Annual Barrington Research Virtual Fall Investment Conference: Covista management will participate in one-on-one investor meetings on Tuesday, September 22, 2026.
